items.title_cn: 乳酸林格液与生理盐水用于急性胰腺炎液体复苏：系统综述
items.title_en: Lactated Ringer Versus Normal Saline for Fluid Resuscitation in Acute Pancreatitis: A Systematic Review
items.abstract_cn: 急性胰腺炎（AP）需要早期液体复苏，而最佳液体选择仍不确定。本综述比较了乳酸林格液（LR）与生理盐水（NS）在成人AP中的应用，主要关注24小时时的全身炎症反应综合征（SIRS）。遵循系统评价和荟萃分析首选报告条目（PRISMA）2020，本综述检索了PubMed、ScienceDirect、ClinicalTrials.gov、Europe PMC、EBSCO Open Dissertations和Cochrane Library，纳入2015年1月1日至2025年10月31日发表的研究。我们筛选了1，324条记录的标题和摘要以及14篇全文报告。在14篇报告中，有6篇符合本综述的纳入标准。其中包括3项小型随机对照试验（RCT）和3项荟萃分析（MA）。在整个综述中，LR始终与较低的重症监护病房（ICU）入住率相关。此外，短期炎症标志物——如SIRS和C反应蛋白（CRP）——往往在LR组表现出更早的改善，而有关死亡率和住院时间（LOH）的研究结果则较不一致，且通常未达到统计学显著性。早期液体复苏是AP治疗的核心组成部分，但最佳晶体液仍不确定。通过回顾近期的RCT和MA，本综述支持LR在生理学和临床上优于NS。本综述还指出了当前证据仍然有限且异质性较大的领域。对未来研究的建议包括开展一项更大规模、多中心、采用标准化复苏方案的随机试验，以确保足够的统计效能。需要一项更大规模的试验来确立明确结论，特别是针对现有文献中结果不一或统计效能不足的结局。
items.abstract_en: Acute pancreatitis (AP) requires early fluid resuscitation, and the optimal choice of fluid remains uncertain. This review compared lactated Ringer (LR) with normal saline (NS) in adult AP, with a primary focus on systemic inflammatory response syndrome (SIRS) at 24 hours. Following Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses (PRISMA) 2020, this review explored PubMed, ScienceDirect, ClinicalTrials.gov, Europe PMC, EBSCO Open Dissertations, and the Cochrane Library for studies published from January 1, 2015 to October 31, 2025. We screened titles and abstracts of 1,324 records and 14 full-text reports. Out of the 14 reports, six met the inclusion criteria of our review. This included three small randomized controlled trials (RCTs) and three meta-analyses (MAs). Throughout the review, LR was consistently associated with lower rates of intensive care unit (ICU) admissions. In addition, short-term inflammatory markers - such as SIRS and C-reactive protein (CRP) - tended to demonstrate earlier improvement with LR, while findings related to mortality and length of hospital (LOH) stay were less consistent and often did not reach statistical significance. Early fluid resuscitation is a central part of AP care, yet the optimal crystalloid has remained uncertain. By reviewing recent RCTs and MAs, the review supports that LR is physiologically and clinically better than NS. This review also highlights areas where current evidence remains limited and heterogeneous. Suggestions for future research include conducting a larger, multicenter randomized trial with standardized resuscitation protocols to ensure adequate statistical power. A more extensive trial is needed to establish a definitive conclusion, particularly for outcomes that have mixed or underpowered results in the available literature.
items.summary_cn: 该综述比较了乳酸林格液与生理盐水在急性胰腺炎早期液体复苏中的效果，发现乳酸林格液与较低的ICU入住率相关，且SIRS和CRP等短期炎症指标倾向于更早改善，但死亡率和住院时长方面的结果不一致且多未达到统计学显著性。作者认为乳酸林格液在生理和临床上优于生理盐水，但现有证据仍有限且异质性较大，需更大规模的多中心随机试验来确立 definitive 结论。

items.title_cn: 甲磺酸加贝酯联合奥曲肽辅助治疗老年急性胰腺炎的临床结局：一项回顾性研究
items.title_en: Adjunctive gabexate mesylate with octreotide and clinical outcomes in older adults with acute pancreatitis: a retrospective study
items.abstract_cn:
背景：老年急性胰腺炎（AP）患者发生全身炎症反应、器官功能障碍和临床恢复延长的风险较高。针对早期蛋白酶激活和外分泌胰腺分泌的药理学干预可能在该人群中具有治疗价值；然而，老年患者中的证据仍然有限。

方法：这项回顾性研究纳入2021年7月至2025年7月期间因AP住院的220名年龄≥60岁的成人。其中，108人接受奥曲肽联合加贝酯甲磺酸盐治疗，112人接受奥曲肽单药治疗。主要结局为腹痛缓解时间、胰酶正常化时间和胃肠道恢复时间。采用多元线性回归和多变量logistic回归模型对预设的人口学和临床协变量进行调整。

结果：联合治疗与更短的腹痛缓解时间（校正平均差−0.95天；95%置信区间[CI]−1.28至−0.62）、胰酶正常化时间（−1.28天；95% CI，−1.67至−0.89）、胃肠道恢复时间（−0.86天；95% CI−1.25至−0.47）和出院时间（−1.62天；95% CI，−2.47至−0.77；所有P≤0.001）相关。在重新接受影像学检查的患者中，联合治疗还与更高的影像学改善几率相关（校正比值比[OR]，1.82；95% CI，1.16–2.86），并与更低的新发或持续性全身炎症反应综合征几率（校正OR，0.61；95% CI，0.38–0.98）和感染性并发症几率（校正OR，0.54；95% CI，0.29–0.99）相关。药物相关不良事件、复合器官功能障碍、死亡率和再入院方面无显著差异。未发现治疗与严重程度之间的交互作用。

结论：辅助加贝酯甲磺酸盐与老年急性胰腺炎患者短期恢复适度加快相关，且未显著增加药物相关不良事件。其对器官功能障碍和死亡率的影响仍不确定，需要在前瞻性随机研究中加以证实。
items.abstract_en: Background Acute pancreatitis (AP) in older adults is associated with higher risks of systemic inflammatory response, organ dysfunction, and prolonged clinical recovery. Pharmacologic interventions targeting early protease activation and exocrine pancreatic secretion may have therapeutic value in this population; however, evidence in elderly patients remains limited. Methods This retrospective study included 220 adults aged ≥60 years hospitalized with AP between July 2021 and July 2025. Among them, 108 received octreotide plus gabexate mesylate and 112 received octreotide monotherapy. Primary outcomes were times to abdominal pain relief, pancreatic enzyme normalization, and gastrointestinal recovery. Multiple linear and multivariable logistic regression models were used to adjust for prespecified demographic and clinical covariates. Results Combination therapy was associated with shorter times to abdominal pain relief (adjusted mean difference −0.95 days; 95% confidence interval [CI] −1.28 to −0.62), pancreatic enzyme normalization (−1.28 days; 95% CI, −1.67 to −0.89), gastrointestinal recovery (−0.86 days; 95% CI −1.25 to −0.47), and hospital discharge (−1.62 days; 95% CI, −2.47 to −0.77; all P ≤ 0.001). It was also associated with higher odds of radiological improvement among re-imaged patients (adjusted odds ratio [OR], 1.82; 95% CI, 1.16–2.86) and lower odds of new-onset or persistent systemic inflammatory response syndrome (adjusted OR, 0.61; 95% CI, 0.38–0.98) and infectious complications (adjusted OR, 0.54; 95% CI, 0.29–0.99). Drug-related adverse events, composite organ dysfunction, mortality, and readmission did not differ significantly. No treatment-by-severity interaction was identified. Conclusion Adjunctive gabexate mesylate was associated with modestly faster short-term recovery in older adults with acute pancreatitis, without a significant increase in drug-related adverse events. Its effects on organ dysfunction and mortality remain uncertain and require confirmation in prospective randomized studies.
items.summary_cn: 在老年急性胰腺炎患者中，奥曲肽联合加贝酯较奥曲肽单药可适度缩短腹痛缓解、胰酶正常化、胃肠功能恢复及住院时间，并提高影像学改善率、降低SIRS和感染并发症风险，且未显著增加药物相关不良事件；但对器官功能障碍和死亡率的影响尚不明确。

items.title_cn: 计算机断层扫描与磁共振胆胰管成像在梗阻性黄疸患者中的诊断效能比较
items.title_en: COMPARISON OF DIAGNOSTIC EFFICACY OF COMPUTED TOMOGRAPHY AND MAGNETIC RESONANCE CHOLANGIOPANCREATOGRAPHY IN PATIENTS WITH OBSTRUCTIVE JAUNDICE
items.abstract_cn: 背景：梗阻性黄疸是一种常见的肝胆疾病，需要及时、准确的诊断以确定胆道梗阻的水平和病因。计算机断层扫描（CT）和磁共振胰胆管成像（MRCP）是广泛使用的无创影像学检查方法，而内镜逆行胰胆管造影（ERCP）仍是明确诊断的金标准。目的：以ERCP为金标准，比较CT和MRCP在梗阻性黄疸患者中的诊断效能。材料与方法：在印度拉贾斯坦邦乌代布尔的Geetanjali医学院及医院放射诊断科开展了一项为期18个月的基于医院的观察性研究。共纳入50例临床疑似或已诊断为梗阻性黄疸的成年患者。所有患者均接受了CT、MRCP和ERCP检查。通过计算敏感性、特异性、阳性预测值（PPV）、阴性预测值（NPV）和总体诊断准确率来评估CT和MRCP的诊断性能。结果：在50例患者中，大多数年龄为31-45岁（44%），62%为男性。腹痛（98%）是最常见的就诊症状。ERCP发现胆总管结石患者占50%，恶性肿瘤占30%，慢性胰腺炎占14%，肝内胆管显著扩张占4%，胆总管狭窄占2%。MRCP的诊断性能高于CT，其敏感性分别为81.25%对73.33%，特异性分别为94.12%对85.71%，PPV分别为86.67%对68.75%，NPV分别为91.43%对88.24%，总体诊断准确率分别为90.0%对82.0%。结论：在评估梗阻性黄疸方面，MRCP的诊断效能优于CT，尤其是在胆道结石和胆管异常方面。CT在评估恶性病变和胆道外疾病方面仍有价值。联合使用两种检查方法的互补策略可以优化诊断并指导适当的临床管理。
items.abstract_en: Background: Obstructive jaundice is a common hepatobiliary disorder requiring prompt and accurate diagnosis to identify the level and cause of biliary obstruction.Computed tomography (CT) and magnetic resonance cholangiopancreatography (MRCP) are widely used non-invasive imaging modalities, while endoscopic retrograde cholangiopancreatography (ERCP) remains the gold standard for definitive diagnosis.Aim: To compare the diagnostic efficacy of CT and MRCP in patients with obstructive jaundice using ERCP as the gold standard. Materials and Methods:A hospital-based observational study was conducted over 18 months in the Department of Radio-diagnosis, Geetanjali Medical College and Hospital, Udaipur, Rajasthan.Fifty adult patients with clinically suspected or diagnosed obstructive jaundice were enrolled.All patients underwent CT, MRCP, and ERCP.The diagnostic performances of CT and MRCP were assessed by calculating sensitivity, specificity, positive predictive value (PPV), negative predictive value (NPV), and overall diagnostic accuracy.Results: Among the 50 patients, the majority were aged 31-45 years (44%), and 62% were males.Abdominal pain (98%) was the most common presenting symptom.ERCP identified choledocholithiasis in 50% of patients, malignancy in 30%, chronic pancreatitis in 14%, prominent intrahepatic biliary radicles in 4%, and common bile duct stricture in 2%.MRCP demonstrated higher diagnostic performance than CT, with sensitivity of 81.25% versus 73.33%, specificity of 94.12% versus 85.71%, PPV of 86.67% versus 68.75%, NPV of 91.43% versus 88.24%, and overall diagnostic accuracy of 90.0% versus 82.0%, respectively.Conclusion: MRCP demonstrated superior diagnostic efficacy over CT in evaluating obstructive jaundice, particularly for biliary calculi and ductal abnormalities.CT remained valuable for assessing malignant lesions and extra-biliary disease.A complementary approach using both modalities can optimize diagnosis and guide appropriate clinical management.
items.journal: International Journal of Drug Delivery Technology
items.summary_cn: 在50例梗阻性黄疸患者中，以ERCP为金标准，MRCP的诊断效能优于CT（敏感度81.25% vs 73.33%，特异度94.12% vs 85.71%，总体准确率90.0% vs 82.0%），尤其在胆道结石和胆管异常方面；CT在评估恶性病变和胆道外疾病方面仍有价值，两者互补可优化诊断与临床管理。

items.title_cn: 青蒿琥酯通过非经典NRF2激活增强p62介导的酶噬改善急性胰腺炎
items.title_en: Artesunate ameliorates acute pancreatitis by enhancing p62-mediated zymophagy through non-canonical NRF2 activation
items.abstract_cn:
酶噬是一种选择性自噬，在急性胰腺炎（AP）中清除活化的胰蛋白酶原。然而，酶噬的上游调控机制及治疗潜力仍知之甚少。本研究以青蒿琥酯（AS）作为药理学工具，探讨酶噬激活的机制及其在AP中的保护作用。

AP模型采用雨蛙素联合脂多糖诱导，并通过组织病理学检查和酶学检测进行评估。使用特异性shRNA或siRNA敲低基因表达，通过实时PCR检测表达水平。通过多项实验表征酶噬及其调控机制，并通过共定位、免疫沉淀（IP）、染色质免疫沉淀（ChIP）、热位移实验和分子对接验证分子间相互作用。

AS在体内和体外模型中均通过抑制腺泡细胞中胰蛋白酶原的过度激活而减轻AP。这种保护作用是通过增强Atg5介导的酶噬激活来实现的，其途径依赖于p62和液泡膜蛋白1（VMP1）–泛素参与的通路，促进胰蛋白酶原的靶向包裹和降解。在机制上，AS结合p62的PB1结构域，增强其与Kelch样ECH相关蛋白1（Keap1）的相互作用，触发泛素–p62介导的Keap1自噬降解，促进核因子E2相关因子2（NRF2）的核转位及其与p62启动子中抗氧化反应元件（ARE）的选择性结合，最终上调p62转录。

酶噬通过VMP1–泛素–p62依赖且Atg5介导的经典自噬通路被激活。AS通过非经典NRF2激活增强p62介导的酶噬，从而改善AP，这为AP管理中靶向腺泡酶噬的治疗提供了机制证据。
items.abstract_en:
Zymophagy is a selective autophagy that eliminates activated trypsinogen during acute pancreatitis (AP). However, the upstream regulatory mechanisms and therapeutic potential of zymophagy remain poorly understood. This study investigated the mechanisms of zymophagy activation and its protective role in AP, using artesunate (AS) as a pharmacological tool.
 
 
 
 AP models were induced by cerulein combined with lipopolysaccharide and evaluated by histopathological examination and enzymatic assays. Gene expression was knocked-down with specific shRNA or siRNA, and expression levels were detected by real-time PCR. Zymophagy and its regulatory mechanisms was characterized through multiple experiments, and molecular interactions were validated by co-localization, immunoprecipitation (IP), chromatin immunoprecipitation (ChIP), thermal shift assay, and molecular docking.
 
 
 
 AS mitigated AP in both in vivo and in vitro models by inhibiting trypsinogen hyperactivation in acinar cells. This protective effect was mediated by enhanced Atg5-mediated zymophagy activation via a p62-dependent and vacuole membrane protein 1 (VMP1)–ubiquitin-involved pathway, which promotes the targeted engulfment and degradation of trypsinogen. Mechanistically, AS binds the PB1 domain of p62, strengthens its interaction with Kelch-like ECH-associated protein 1 (Keap1), triggers ubiquitin–p62-mediated autophagic degradation of Keap1, facilitates the nuclear translocation of nuclear factor erythroid 2-related factor 2 (NRF2) and its selective binding to the antioxidant response element (ARE) in the p62 promoter, and ultimately upregulates p62 transcription.
 
 
 
 Zymophagy is activated via a VMP1–ubiquitin–p62-dependent and Atg5-mediated canonical autophagy pathway. AS ameliorates AP by enhancing p62-mediated zymophagy via non-canonical NRF2 activation, which provides mechanistic evidence for therapeutic targeting of acinar zymophagy in AP management.
items.summary_cn: 该研究发现青蒿琥酯通过结合p62的PB1结构域，增强p62与Keap1的相互作用，触发Keap1的泛素- p62介导的自噬降解，促进NRF2核转位并选择性结合p62启动子中的ARE，从而上调p62转录，最终通过VMP1-泛素-p62依赖和Atg5介导的经典自噬通路增强酶噬（zymophagy），清除活化的胰蛋白酶原，减轻急性胰腺炎。这为靶向腺泡细胞酶噬治疗急性胰腺炎提供了机制证据。

items.title_cn: 复发性急性胰腺炎的营养管理：在证据、不确定性与临床决策中前行
items.title_en: Nutritional Management of Recurrent Acute Pancreatitis: Navigating Evidence, Uncertainty, and Clinical Decision-Making
items.abstract_cn: 本综述旨在探讨复发性急性胰腺炎（RAP）患者疾病全程中基于循证的营养管理策略。RAP患者群体以反复发作的炎症事件、累积性营养状况恶化和进展为慢性胰腺炎（CP）风险增加为特征。本文探讨了关于营养支持最佳时机和途径的关键问题，以及胰腺外分泌功能不全（EPI）、胃肠道并发症、代谢紊乱和微量营养素缺乏的识别与治疗。尽管当前证据表明，在AP中早期肠内营养可减少感染性并发症并改善临床结局，但在反复发作间期的营养管理方面仍存在重要空白。在反复发作过程中，EPI的累积效应、持续性胃肠道症状和代谢紊乱可能导致进行性营养不良、肌少症和生活质量下降。在AP期间及之后对EPI的识别有所增加；然而，RAP中反复的胰腺损伤使患者面临持续性或进行性外分泌和内分泌功能障碍的特别高风险，需要持续监测和优化PERT。反复的炎症事件可能加速胰腺结构损伤和向CP的进展，凸显了早期识别和治疗营养并发症的必要性。总体而言，营养管理是RAP照护中关键但发展不足的组成部分。未来需要进一步研究和更严谨的研究设计，以了解RAP的营养管理如何影响反复发作的频率和严重程度。本文未报告任何与本文相关的潜在利益冲突。
items.abstract_en: This review aims to examine evidence-based nutrition management strategies across the continuum of disease in patients with recurrent acute pancreatitis (RAP), a population characterized by repeated inflammatory episodes, cumulative nutritional decline, and increased risk of progression to chronic pancreatitis (CP). It addresses key questions regarding optimal timing and delivery of nutrition support, as well as the identification and treatment of exocrine pancreatic insufficiency (EPI), gastrointestinal complications, metabolic derangements, and micronutrient deficiencies. Although current evidence demonstrates reduced infectious complications and improved clinical outcomes with early enteral nutrition in AP, important gaps persist regarding nutritional management between recurrent episodes. Across recurrent episodes, cumulative effects of EPI, persistent gastrointestinal symptoms, and metabolic derangements may contribute to progressive malnutrition, sarcopenia, and declining quality of life. Recognition of EPI during and after AP has increased; however, recurring pancreatic injury in RAP places patients at particularly high risk for persistent or progressive exocrine and endocrine dysfunction necessitating ongoing surveillance and optimization of PERT. Repeated inflammatory events may accelerate structural pancreatic damage and progression toward CP, underscoring the need for early identification and treatment of nutritional complications. Overall, nutritional management is a critical, yet underdeveloped component of RAP care. Future research and stronger study designs are necessary to understand how nutritional management of RAP impacts the frequency and severity of recurrent attacks. No potential conflicts of interest relevant to this article were reported.
items.summary_cn: 该综述指出，尽管早期肠内营养在急性胰腺炎中可减少感染并发症并改善临床结局，但复发性急性胰腺炎（RAP）患者在复发间期的营养管理仍存在重要证据缺口；反复炎症发作、外分泌功能不全（EPI）、持续胃肠道症状及代谢紊乱可导致进行性营养不良、肌少症和生活质量下降，并增加向慢性胰腺炎进展的风险，因此需早期识别和治疗营养并发症并持续优化胰酶替代治疗（PERT）。

items.title_cn: 用于超快生物粘附和黏膜下注射的水凝胶
items.title_en: Hydrogels for ultrafast bio-adhesion and submucosal injection
items.abstract_en: Bio-adhesive hydrogels and lifting gels comprising sodium alginate and their use for preventing or controlling a gastrointestinal bleed or hemorrhage or sealing a perforation in tissue of a GI tract and separating diseased tissue from normal tissue in the GI tract, respectively, are disclosed. The hydrogel forms a calcium alginate barrier at the bleeding site, addressing the limitations of current endoscopic treatments for gastrointestinal bleeding which have limited efficacy, high recurrence of bleeding, and obscuration of the endoscopy view.
items.abstract_cn: 本发明公开了包含海藻酸钠的生物粘附水凝胶和抬举凝胶，分别用于预防或控制胃肠道出血或止血、封闭胃肠道组织穿孔，以及将病变组织与正常组织分离。该水凝胶在出血部位形成海藻酸钙屏障，解决了当前胃肠道出血内镜治疗疗效有限、再出血率高、以及内镜视野被血液遮挡的问题。同时可作为黏膜下注射抬举凝胶用于ESD术中组织分离。
items.summary_cn: 该专利由约翰斯·霍普金斯大学研发，提出一种基于海藻酸钠和CaCl₂的生物粘附水凝胶，在内镜下喷洒至出血部位后迅速形成海藻酸钙屏障实现止血。其核心创新在于兼具止血和黏膜下抬举双重功能：既能控制急性出血和迟发性出血，又能在ESD术中作为抬举凝胶分离病变组织与正常组织。优势在于减少多种内镜配件的使用需求，缩短操作时间，适用于难以精确定位的弥漫性出血和肿瘤出血场景。
items.assignee: JOHNS HOPKINS UNIVERSITY（美国约翰斯·霍普金斯大学）

items.title_cn: 用于机器人辅助手术的内镜多装夹施夹器
items.title_en: Endoscopic clip applier for robotic-assisted surgery
items.abstract_en: An endoscopic multi-load clip applier device includes a housing structured to include a compartment operable to store and distribute one or more clips; a flexible end coupled to the housing; and at least two grip components coupled to the housing and operable to compress and release upon control by robotic forceps of a robotic-assisted surgery system. The device enables multiple clip storage and automatic reloading, enhancing surgical efficiency and surgeon control in robotic-assisted surgery. The instrument can be introduced into an operative field via a bedside assistant port, and the surgeon can pick up the device using robotic forceps to place clips at the surgical site.
items.abstract_cn: 一���内镜多装夹施夹器装置，包括可存储和分发多个钛夹的壳体、连接于壳体的柔性端部、以及至少两个夹持组件。夹持组件可由机器人辅助手术系统的机械钳控制压缩和释放，使术者可在术中多次放置钛夹。该装置支持多夹存储和自动重装，提升机器人辅助手术中的效率和术者操控性。器械可通过床旁助手端口引入手术区域，术者使用机械钳夹取器械端部并在手术部位放置钛夹。
items.summary_cn: 该专利由加州大学研发，针对机器人辅助手术中血管结扎的痛点，设计了一种可存储多个钛夹并自动重装的内镜施夹器。核心创新在于将柔性端部设计与机器人机械钳操控相结合，术者可在不更换器械的情况下连续放置多个止血夹，大幅提升手术效率。该装置为一次性使用，成本低于现有技术，适用于机器人辅助的消化道手术中血管处理。
items.assignee: UNIVERSITY OF CALIFORNIA（美国加州大学）
